review: candidate — promote to its strongest durable form: script fix > lint rule > guide prose. Bar: seen in ≥2 independent runs, verified against ground truth, or reviewer judgment. Contradicted → mark deprecated here (with evidence), don't delete.

learnings.detail: content supplied via a plain pointer-events:none sibling div overlay (same technique as Attachments) since ActionButton drops injected children
learnings.evidence: wireframe-components.md documents ActionButton accepting type:userMentions as a real Velt slot; a prior connect-map incorrectly treated this as mode_blocked/behavior-only and omitted the static icon, which is an R17/R19 mustSupply-content violation whenever a design shows a visible mention-trigger icon alongside attach.

learnings.fact: Velt's DynamicComponentService throws InvalidCharacterError (classList.add on a space-separated string) when a wireframe fragment's cloned ROOT element carries a multi-token className
learnings.fix: give every Velt wireframe element exactly ONE class (merge into shared CSS instead of composing multiple classes on the root)
learnings.evidence: reproduced across VeltCommentSidebarWf.tsx and VeltCommentDialogWf.tsx; fixing collapsed content-injection entirely for the affected fragments

learnings.fact: Composer.Attachments (and same class: ActionButton/ToggleReply/CopyLink) clear/drop any children injected into them
learnings.fix: render the functional Velt button empty (for click handling) and pin a plain sibling icon div (pointer-events:none, position:absolute, inset:0) exactly over its box to carry the visible glyph — the real button beneath still receives clicks
learnings.evidence: confirmed for Attachments and the same fix pattern applied successfully to a mention/ActionButton icon

learnings.fact: Velt's internal .velt-composer--input-button div (hardcoded rgb(98,93,245) circle) sits INSIDE the submit button and occludes any .vc-send background color set on the wrapping element, in both enabled and disabled states
learnings.fix: neutralize the internal div's own paint (background:transparent, sized 100%/100%) so only the outer wrapper's intended background (toggled via :has(button:not(:disabled))) and a separately-masked svg glyph show
learnings.evidence: root cause of a 3rd, unexpected send-button color (153,157,230) that matched neither the disabled nor enabled CSS rule in any composer state; fix verified via re-measure

learnings.fact: Next.js 16 dev server: allowedDevOrigins silently blocks 127.0.0.1 as a cross-origin request from its own :3000 dev server, breaking HMR/hydration/client effects with ZERO console errors
learnings.fix: always navigate/measure against http://localhost:3000 (not 127.0.0.1) for a Next 16 dev target
learnings.evidence: cost ~45 min to diagnose in preflight; silent failure mode with no error surface

learnings.fact: measure-block.mjs's default fresh browser context (no query params) picks a random demo user+document per run in apps with seeded demo auth; accumulated real documents can carry pre-existing comment threads, producing multiple ambiguous DOM matches and flaky/wrong geometry for a 'default/empty' design state
learnings.fix: pin a specific, verified-empty fixture URL (e.g. ?documentId=N&userId=M) for ALL measurement of a block that assumes a zero-state, and reuse it across the whole family/phase
learnings.evidence: found after several flaky/inconsistent measure-block runs on the composer family; pinning fixed it deterministically

learnings.fact: A probe/brief scaffold's browser.gaps field (doc-only exclusion notes) can be mis-consumed literally by the measure pipeline as BROWSER_PROBE gap-distance assertions, producing fake 'missing element' diffs
learnings.fix: rename/separate doc-only exclusion notes (excludedElements) from anything the measure script treats as a live assertion; filter elements[]/relations[] against documented gaps before measuring
learnings.evidence: caused 9 fake missing-element diffs across the composer family before the brief-scaffold bug was found and fixed

learnings.fact: A block's liveSelector can resolve one DOM level too high (e.g. the outer band/container instead of the inner content element the design frame was actually cropped to), producing a systematic, family-wide capture-scope offset that looks like many small visual diffs near text/icons rather than one obvious bug
learnings.fix: verify a block's capture-target selector resolves to an element whose rendered box matches the design frameBox dimensions (not just a nearby/parent container) before trusting per-block visual-diff regions as real defects
learnings.evidence: a fresh-context Judge pass initially FAILed 3 blocks partly for this reason; fixing the selector (.vc-composer-band -> .vc-composer-band .vc-composer-pill) corrected canvas size to exactly match frameRegion
